pipeline.dashboardDescription: Latest stored batches by agent and recent run history. Opening this page never starts an eval.
pipeline.limitation: Scoring is positional: exact file and overlapping lines in the frozen diff. It measures this curated rubric, not semantic correctness. No model call is used for scoring.

metricReason.incomplete: A complete successful batch is required.
metricReason.noPositives: No must-find expectations: recall has no denominator.
metricReason.noPredictions: No predictions: this metric has no denominator.

pipeline.wrongAgent: This stored run belongs to another agent. Open it from that agent’s Evals tab.

comparison.sameRun: Choose two different runs to compare.
comparison.incomplete: One or both runs did not complete successfully. Metric deltas are unavailable.
comparison.differentSuite: The dataset or scoring profile differs. Metric deltas are unavailable.
comparison.comparable: Both runs use the same frozen dataset and scoring profile. Defined metrics can be compared.

pipeline.emptyCases: No frozen cases yet. Accept or reject a source review finding, then use Turn into eval case.
pipeline.unsupported: Unsupported cases prevent this suite from running.
pipeline.immutable: This case is frozen. Later source decisions or PR changes do not alter its input or expectation.
pipeline.provenance: Source provenance and frozen input metadata
